keyFindings.description: A pull request merged while the issue is in implementing (or before a return to implementing) now stalls the issue: the completion is refused HANDOFF_NO_PULL_REQUEST (handoff.go:280-286) and the guard needs an open record (workflow/table.go:63), but nothing is recorded, so the pass never sends pull-request-missing (record/store.go HandedOffWithoutOpenPullRequest needs handoff_commit), and the architect's pr-merged guidance (prompts/go/architect-common.md:18, skills/legion-architect/references/wake-routing.md:30) still says the workflow runs on and no further notice follows. On main the merged record let the issue advance.

Lag (consume.go:364-372) reads the three consumers in sequence under one 2 s deadline; NATS answers a permission-refused STREAM.MSG.GET with an async -ERR only, so before the envoy-infra grant rolls out one waiting Dispatch consumer spends the whole bound and the server and github consumers show waiting 0 / unavailable. The PR body's rollout note (oldest reads unavailable) understates it; the tests' stand-in refuses at once.

The sweep now retries a 422/503 for 72 h (2,4,8,16,32 then 60 min, about 76 requests); each retry logs the refused/failed line the webhook-refused and publish-failure alarms count, and the alarm (Period 300, 1 period, notBreaching, Alarm and OK actions on the topic, infra/aws/webhooklistener.go:272-282) flips ALARM/OK about 74 times per persistently refused delivery where it used to fire once. Neither bounded nor named in the PR.

No `## Contract change census`: the PR adds the HANDOFF_NO_PULL_REQUEST refusal on POST /legion/v1/handoff/complete and required state fields (consumers, repositories.withoutWebhookApp) under daemon API contract 42 that a 41 plugin's strict reader refuses.

consume.go:252-254 logs ERROR 'any event published between was lost' whenever the last applied fact is older than the stream's first message, which happens on a quiet project (positions advance only on applied facts, position.go:39-51), though the consumer may have handled every message.
